# Assignment 1. Handwritten digit recognition with K-nearest neighbors

```{r a1-data}
library(kknn)

# optdigits.csv has no header: 64 pixel columns + last column = digit (0-9)
digits <- read.csv("data/optdigits.csv", header = FALSE)
colnames(digits)[ncol(digits)] <- "digit"
digits$digit <- as.factor(digits$digit)
```

# Assignment 2. Linear regression and ridge regression

```{r a2-data}
# check.names = FALSE keeps the original column names, e.g. "Jitter(%)"
parkinsons <- read.csv("data/parkinsons.csv", check.names = FALSE)

# Keep only the target and the 16 voice features
# (drops subject#, age, sex, test_time, total_UPDRS)
parkinsons <- parkinsons[, c("motor_UPDRS", colnames(parkinsons)[7:22])]
```
